# [2.0.0](https://github.com/igorvelho/opencode-session-cost/compare/v1.1.0...v2.0.0) (2026-10-14)


* feat!: support OpenCode 2.x and focus on subagent cost breakdown ([2ee7608](https://github.com/igorvelho/opencode-session-cost/commit/2ee760855272292e5d228b1d6a6fba5b3c4737d5))


### BREAKING CHANGES

* drop OpenCode 1.x support; requires OpenCode 2.0.28 or newer.

- migrate to @opencode/plugin/tui and Plugin.define entrypoint
- update slot to sidebar.content and match native collapsible V2 layout
- update session listing to use paginated v2 client API
- hide block when session has 0 subagents
- display combined subagent spend and collapsible per-subagent cost breakdown
